tests.pins: Incremental re-runs that compare models (FullModel.Equals delegating to ObjectSerializationInfo.Equals) do not throw, keep output identical for unrelated edits and regenerate when an object's members change.

MessagePackGenerator.Generate emits via FormatterTemplate a compiling <Type>Formatter for int-key classes/structs that writes an array header of MaxKey+1, throws on nil for structs and invokes serialization callbacks.

GetAnalyzerOption merges IMessagePackFormatter<T> implementations found in the compilation into the options used by the generators and falls back to IsGeneratingSource=true options when no [GeneratedMessagePackResolver] exists, so generation still compiles.
